description: This file defines the main App component for a React frontend application, including internal hooks for viewport detection, a desktop-only overlay component, and routing logic. It manages display based on viewport size and environment, and imports external assets, hooks, and routing components.

classes.name: useIsBelowDesktopBreakpoint
classes.description: Custom React hook to detect if viewport width is below a specified breakpoint (default 1024px).

classes.name: DesktopOnlyOverlay
classes.description: React component displaying an overlay message when the viewport is narrower than 1024px, indicating the app is desktop-only.

methods.name: App
methods.description: Main React component that manages routing and overlay display based on viewport size and environment.
